cloud.kicked.title: Started on another PC
cloud.kicked.detail:
This PC stops the game and quits.
Open the app again to continue from the latest progress.
This window closes in 30 seconds.
cloud.held.title: Account suspended
cloud.held.detail: Changes that need review were found in the account save, or an operator suspended this account. An operator will review it and apply the result.
update.required.title: Update required
update.required.ready.detail: Restart to apply it and keep saving to your account.
update.required.manual: Install version {version} to keep saving to your account.
cloud.confirm.title: Start on this PC?
cloud.confirm.detail:
Progress that PC did not upload may be lost.
If you start here, that PC stops the game.
Cancel quits the app.
cloud.blocked.title: Can't take over yet
cloud.blocked.tradeActive: A trade is in progress on {other}.
cloud.blocked.tradeActive.detail:
Finish the trade on that PC, then try again.
Quit closes the app.
cloud.blocked.tradeUnsynced: A trade finished on {other} is not saved to the account yet.
cloud.blocked.tradeUnsynced.detail:
Turn on that PC and connect it to the internet to save it.
Then try again.
Quit closes the app.
cloud.lost.title: Save info not found
cloud.lost.member.message: Sign-in info for this PC was not found.
cloud.lost.member.detail:
Sign in again to continue with your account save.
Continue with this PC's save to keep playing without signing in.
cloud.lost.anonymous.message: Anonymous save info for this PC was not found.
cloud.lost.anonymous.gone: The anonymous save on the server cannot be recovered.
cloud.lost.anonymous.fresh: Start over backs up this PC's progress and restarts the app.
cloud.lost.anonymous.tip: Sign in with GitHub so you don't lose it next time.
save.locked.title: Couldn't open your save
save.locked.message: The key for this PC's save file couldn't be used.
save.locked.detail:
Allow keychain access or try again later. Your save is still here.
Start over backs up the current save and starts from the beginning. If your account has a save, pick a Pokémon and your account save comes back.
cloud.handoff.discarded: Switched to your account save. This PC's progress was backed up.
